Arm L3_rel_beat_lr_crop_r1w_motion = round-4 winner L3_rel_beat_lr with a 240-sample cropped output, the x16 R1-step clip, R1 weight 0.1 and an added periodic motion component (0.5-3.5 Hz cadence, 3 harmonics, amplitude up to 1.5x the pulse, set per condition and noise), same seeds, steps and learning-rate schedule as round 4; every round-3 gate unchanged.
Incumbent: L3_rel_beat_lr_crop_r1w, S_arm [0.4574784997424784, 0.5109542926215288, 0.5627118463262404], S_real [0.3341317187370676, 0.36832548420919575, 0.3775194776498169], validation wrist Q [0.6181432876236755, 0.6199171333909531, 0.7208908689027618] (mean S_arm 0.5104).
Ship the arm only if every seed passes the round-3 gates, its mean validation wrist Q beats the incumbent's by more than the pooled seed SD of wrist Q, its mean S_arm is at most the incumbent's mean + the pooled seed SD of S_arm, and its mean S_real is at most the incumbent's + 0.05; the shipped seed is its lowest-S_arm seed. Otherwise the incumbent stays. The GXU test is scored only after this decision is saved.
